tasks.name: Device and Platform Matrix
tasks.objective: Produce the Device and Platform Matrix for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every target platform and hardware class listed with a representative device
Input devices and required parity listed
Which classes are supported versus best-effort is explicit

tasks.name: Compatibility Test Matrix
tasks.objective: Produce the Compatibility Test Matrix for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every row tested on the named device or emulator with a result
Resolution, orientation and safe-area behaviour verified
Failures converted to bug reports with device details

tasks.name: Input Parity Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Input Parity Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every action reachable with every declared input device
Touch targets and gestures verified on a real mobile viewport
